name: J. D. Garver
bio: J. D. Garver, a tinsmith from Bismarck, moved to Medora with his family in August 1884 and opened a hardware store and tin shop, moving into a new building that November. His wife was quite ill at Bismarck in spring 1885, and in August 1885 a Garver child died of cholera infantum. In 1886 he ran a collection box for the school and served on a jury, and in November he left for Winona to go into business because of his wife's continuing illness.
